exposure: endoscopic patterns (chronic gastritis, duodenal ulcers, gastric ulcers)
cohort: Symptomatic adult patients attending the gastroenterology clinic at Kilimanjaro Chistian Medical Centre in Northern Tanzania who had indications for esophagogastroduodenoscopy.
finding: The feco-prevalence of H. pylori was 43.4%, with chronic gastritis being the most common endoscopic pattern, and H. pylori infection was significantly associated with increasing age, blood group, duodenal ulcers, and gastric ulcers.
